Found 71 items in registries @fluid:

Showing items 1-71 of 71:

- surfaces (registry:theme) - Eight-level surface and shadow ladder for elevation. Light: two color steps then flat white, differentiated by shadow. Dark: additive white-opacity ladder with layered inset highlights and drops. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tokens (registry:theme) - Shared interaction-state tokens: surface-relative hover/active overlays (bg-hover, bg-active), the selected fill, the destructive-light ground, the --overlay RGB triplet, the --focus-ring color, and the base-layer :focus-visible fallback ring. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- utils (registry:lib) - Utility function for merging Tailwind CSS classes with clsx and tailwind-merge. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- springs (registry:lib) - Spring animation token presets for Framer Motion (fast, moderate, slow). [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- font-weight (registry:lib) - Variable font weight tokens for Inter (normal, medium, semibold, bold) using font-variation-settings. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- surface-context (registry:lib) - React context that tracks the current substrate elevation level. Elevated components (Dropdown, Select, etc.) read it via useSurface() and render at substrate + offset, then re-provide a new substrate so further nesting elevates further. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- surface-classes (registry:lib) - Static lookup tables for bg-surface-N and shadow-surface-N utilities. Required because Tailwind v4 cannot detect template-literal class names. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- elevated (registry:lib) - Elevation primitive. Wraps the read-substrate / compute-level / apply-classes / re-provide-context pattern into one component. Pulls in the surface theme tokens, substrate context, and class lookup so a single install drops in the whole elevation system. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- popup (registry:lib) - Shared popup chrome for the dropdown, select, and combobox popups: side-aware enter/exit motion classes driven by the positioner's resolved data-side, the ScrollArea sizing the list scrolls inside, and the navigation-key list. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- shape-context (registry:lib) - React context provider for runtime shape variant switching (pill or rounded). Controls border-radius across all Fluid Functionalism components. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- size-context (registry:lib) - React context provider for the two-step size ladder (36px default, 28px compact). Controls control heights, text, icon, and padding scale across all Fluid Functionalism components, and exports the role-based typography scale. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- icon-context (registry:lib) - Named icon slots with a Lucide default set; swap any icon via IconProvider. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-fluid-hover (registry:hook) - Fluid hover: the hook that tracks the item nearest the cursor within a container, and the one highlight component that springs between the rects it measures. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-touch-primary (registry:hook) - Detects touch-primary devices (coarse pointer + touch points), updating live on pointer-mode and media-query changes. Adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh). [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-keyboard-nav-gate (registry:hook) - Gates a popup's keyboard focus ring on keyboard use: seeded at open from the focused element's :focus-visible state, then earned by navigation keys inside the popup. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- use-merge-split (registry:hook) - React hook + renderer for the selected-background merge/split animation. When one row bridges or splits two contiguous selected runs, their inner edges glide together (or apart) and swap to a single block, instead of one block spring-growing over the union. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- accordion (registry:ui) - Collapsible accordion with animated height transitions, spring-animated chevron, and fluid hover in grouped mode. Built on Radix UI Accordion. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- accordion-base (registry:ui) - Collapsible accordion with animated height transitions, spring-animated chevron, and fluid hover in grouped mode. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ask-user-questions (registry:ui) - Stepped question flow with numbered options, keyboard shortcuts (1–9), single or multi-select, inline 'other' text input, optional skip, fluid hover, and multi-question navigation. Auto-advances on selection in single-select. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- badge (registry:ui) - Compact label with solid and dot variants, Tailwind color palette, and three sizes. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button (registry:ui) - Animated button with variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost), icon support, loading spinner, and fluid font-weight transitions on hover. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button-base (registry:ui) - Animated button with variants (primary, secondary, tertiary, ghost), icon support, loading spinner, and fluid font-weight transitions on hover. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dropdown (registry:ui) - Dropdown menu with fluid hover, animated selection indicator, inline panel or triggered popup with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, and close-on-select. Includes MenuItem, DropdownSearch (a search field inside the popup), and multiple selection with merged backgrounds. Radix flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dropdown-base (registry:ui) - Dropdown menu with fluid hover, animated selection indicator, inline panel or triggered popup with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, and close-on-select. Includes MenuItem, DropdownSearch (a search field inside the popup), and multiple selection with merged backgrounds. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- checkbox-group (registry:ui) - Animated checkbox group with fluid hover, contiguous selection merging, and spring-animated check marks. Built on Radix UI Checkbox. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- checkbox-group-base (registry:ui) - Animated checkbox group with fluid hover, contiguous selection merging, and spring-animated check marks. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- radio-group (registry:ui) - Animated radio group with fluid hover, spring-animated selection dot, and optional Radix UI integration. Supports both controlled index and value-based APIs. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- radio-group-base (registry:ui) - Animated radio group with fluid hover, spring-animated selection dot. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dialog (registry:ui) - Animated modal dialog with spring-based scale and opacity transitions in three widths (sm, lg, and an xl canvas for composed layouts such as a sidebar), plus a container prop to scope it to a region. Built on Radix UI Dialog with overlay, header, footer, title, and description sub-components. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dialog-base (registry:ui) - Animated modal dialog with spring-based scale and opacity transitions in three widths (sm, lg, and an xl canvas for composed layouts such as a sidebar), plus a container prop to scope it to a region. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- mobile-drawer (registry:ui) - Slide-in navigation drawer with scrim, focus trap, and scroll lock. Radix flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- mobile-drawer-base (registry:ui) - Slide-in navigation drawer with scrim, focus trap, and scroll lock. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input-copy (registry:ui) - Read-only input with a copy-to-clipboard button and animated check feedback. Supports optional label and shape context. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input-group (registry:ui) - Grouped input fields with fluid hover highlighting, animated label transitions, optional icons, and error states. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input-message (registry:ui) - Chat-style message composer with auto-resizing textarea, drag-and-drop file attachments (PNG / JPEG / PDF), flexible left/right action slots, and a built-in send button on a Surface-2 substrate. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- file-thumbnail (registry:ui) - Read-only square preview of a File. Images render via object-cover; PDFs render their first page via pdfjs; a spinner shows while either resolves. Adapts its corner radius to the global shape setting. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- queued-stack (registry:block) - Sonner-style stack of queued composer messages: collapsed cards fan out on hover (tap on touch), drag to reorder, a gutter arrow counts the overflow, edit/remove per card, and a shared-layout morph into the sent message. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chat-message (registry:ui) - A single chat transcript entry with baked-in entrance and layout motion. Right-aligned accent bubble for the user, left-aligned muted bubble for the assistant, with optional file attachments. Adapts to the global shape setting. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tabs-subtle (registry:ui) - Horizontal tab navigation with fluid hover, animated pill selection indicator, and fluid font-weight transitions. Radix flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tabs-subtle-base (registry:ui) - Horizontal tab navigation with fluid hover, animated pill selection indicator, and fluid font-weight transitions. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- switch (registry:ui) - Animated toggle switch with spring-based thumb animation and fluid font-weight label transitions. Built on Radix UI Switch. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- switch-base (registry:ui) - Animated toggle switch with spring-based thumb animation and fluid font-weight label transitions. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- carousel-dots (registry:ui) - Carousel dots, static or on autoplay: fluid-hover click areas, and a current pill that fills over each slide's duration. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- table (registry:ui) - Animated table with fluid hover row highlighting and fluid border transitions. Includes TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, and TableCell sub-components. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- card (registry:ui) - shadcn's compositional card (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter) with the Fluid Functionalism layer: transparent substrate, weight-animated title, media/logo/feature/image slots, and a CardGroup that owns stacked, inline, and grid layouts plus 2-D fluid-hover highlighting. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar (registry:ui) - Refined, composable app sidebar with offcanvas collapse, floating and inset variants, a mobile drawer, cookie-persisted state, keyboard shortcut, and fluid-hover menus with traveling selection, hover, and focus indicators. Radix flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar-base (registry:ui) - Refined, composable app sidebar with offcanvas collapse, floating and inset variants, a mobile drawer, cookie-persisted state, keyboard shortcut, and fluid-hover menus with traveling selection, hover, and focus indicators. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar-menu-grid (registry:lib) - Shared popup geometry for sidebar-anchored dropdown menus: trigger width +10px shifted -4px, items on the rows' leading and text axes, trailing glyphs on the trigger chevron's axis. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar-workspace-header (registry:block) - Workspace brand row for a sidebar header: 20px tile on the rows' leading axis, name pinned to the 32px text axis, trigger cross-fading into the tile's slot while the collapsed rail peeks, and a trigger-width switcher menu on the shared sidebar grid. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar-user-footer (registry:block) - Footer identity row: a 20px avatar centred on the rows' leading icon axis, chevron on the trailing action axis, and an upward user menu on the shared sidebar grid so its rows align with the trigger exactly. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar-search-field (registry:block) - Header search on the menu rows' rhythm: leading icon on the rows' 16px axis, text on the 32px axis, and a hover-revealed keystroke chip at the trailing edge. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar-inset-topbar (registry:block) - The main region's topbar: h-12 with the trigger that hides while the rail peeks and fades back in at its settled spot after a pin. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- sidebar-app (registry:block) - A complete app shell: workspace header with the peek cross-fade, search on the menu rows' rhythm with a hover-revealed shortcut chip, collapsible sections with label actions and badges, a user footer, and an inset topbar whose trigger fades back in at its settled position after a pin. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dialog-sidebar (registry:block) - A settings dialog: the xl Dialog as a canvas, a non-collapsing Sidebar of sections down its left edge, and a scrolling panel of controls — switches, selects, and an input group. Below the sm breakpoint a Select takes over navigation. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- slider (registry:ui) - Animated slider with spring-snapped thumb, step dots, range mode, and click-to-edit value display. Built on Radix UI Slider. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- slider-base (registry:ui) - Animated slider with spring-snapped thumb, step dots, range mode, and click-to-edit value display. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tabs (registry:ui) - Segmented control tabs with sliding active indicator, fluid hover, and spring animations. Built on Radix UI Tabs. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tabs-base (registry:ui) - Segmented control tabs with sliding active indicator, fluid hover, and spring animations. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- thinking-indicator (registry:ui) - Animated loading indicator with morphing SVG path (circle to infinity loop) and shimmer text rotation. Cycles through customizable status words. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- scroll-area (registry:ui) - Scroll container with a restyled overlay scrollbar that stays discoverable on hover and follows the shape system. Falls back to native overflow scrolling on touch-primary devices. Built on Radix UI Scroll Area; adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh). [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- scroll-area-base (registry:ui) - Scroll container with a restyled overlay scrollbar that stays discoverable on hover and follows the shape system. Falls back to native overflow scrolling on touch-primary devices. Base UI flavor; adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh). [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- select (registry:ui) - Animated select menu with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, fluid hover, spring-animated popover, and animated checkmark. Radix flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- select-base (registry:ui) - Animated select menu with collision-aware positioning, typeahead, fluid hover, spring-animated popover, and animated checkmark. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- combobox (registry:ui) - Type-to-filter combobox with single or multiple (chips, merged selection backgrounds) selection: a text field that filters a list as you type, with keyboard highlight, fluid hover, spring-animated popover, animated checkmark, and clear/chevron controls. Optional create-from-query row (onCreate) and hideSelected for chips fields. Radix flavor (Popover + hand-rolled listbox). [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- combobox-base (registry:ui) - Type-to-filter combobox with single or multiple (chips, merged selection backgrounds) selection: a text field that filters a list as you type, with keyboard highlight, fluid hover, spring-animated popover, animated checkmark, and clear/chevron controls. Optional create-from-query row (onCreate) and hideSelected for chips fields. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- command-menu (registry:ui) - Search field over a list of actions: type to filter, arrows to move the fluid hover highlight, Enter to run. Grouped rows with icons, descriptions, and shortcut caps; suggestions listed first while nothing is typed; subtle tabs or a borderless filter bar under the field; and a dialog shell opened by a global shortcut (default ⌘K / Ctrl+K). The list needs no primitive; the dialog is the library's Dialog in either flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tooltip (registry:ui) - Floating tooltip with spring-based animations, configurable placement, and rich content support. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tooltip-base (registry:ui) - Floating tooltip with spring-based animations, configurable placement, and rich content support. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- thinking-steps (registry:ui) - Collapsible AI reasoning steps with animated expand/collapse, per-step icons, sources, and nested details. Radix flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- thinking-steps-base (registry:ui) - Collapsible AI reasoning steps with animated expand/collapse, per-step icons, sources, and nested details. Base UI flavor. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- color-picker (registry:ui) - Color picker with HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH formats, alpha channel, optional swatches, and a popover trigger. Built on Base UI's Popover, Menu, and NumberField primitives with native EyeDropper support. [@fluid] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
